Yoruba: Ọnà kan láti ran àwọn aláṣẹ lọ́wọ́ ni láti nípa fífún wọn ní dátà àti ṣíṣe àsọtẹ́lè bí ó ti ṣeé se kí àrùn COVID-19 tàn ká.
Zulu: Enye indlela yokusiza abathathi-zinqumo kwakuwukubanikeza ingcobelela nezibikezelo zokuthi i-COVID-19 ingasabalala kanjani.
Hausa: Hanya ɗaya don taimakawa masu yanke shawara ita ce ba su bayanai da hasashen yadda cutar COVID-19 za ta iya yaɗuwa.
Northern Sotho: Tsela e tee ya go thuša batho bao ba tšeago diphetho e bile go ba fa datha le dikakanyo tša mabapi le ka moo COVID-19 e ka phatlalalago.
Amharic: ውሳኔ-ሰጪዎችን ለመርዳት አንዱ መንገድ ኮቪድ-19 እንዴት ሊሰራጭ እንደሚችል መረጃ እና ትንበያዎችን መስጠት ነበር፡፡

Source: Researchers thus used South African, Chinese, and Italian data to update a commonly-used computer model.
Luganda: Olw’ensonga eyo, abanoonyereza baakozesa obubaka okuva mu South Afirika, China ne Yitale okuzza obuggya omutetenkanyirizo gw’oku kompyuta ogwakozesebwa ennyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwád̀í wá lo dátà ilẹ̀ South Africa, China, àti Italy láti ṣe ìmúpé àwòṣe ajẹ́mọ́kọ̀m̀pútà kan tí ó wọ́pọ̀ fún lílò.
Zulu: Ngakho abacwaningi basebenzisa ingcobelela yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-China, ne-Italy ukuze babuyekeze imodeli yekhompyutha evame ukusetshenziswa.
Hausa: Don haka, masu binciken sun yi amfani da bayanan Afirka ta Kudu da Sin da kuma Italiya domin sabunta tsarin kwamfuta da aka saba amfani da su.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ka gona ba šomišitše datha ya Afrika Borwa, China le Ithalia go mpshafatša mmotlolo wa khophutha wo o šomišwago ka bontši.
Amharic: ስለዚህ ተመራማሪዎች በተለምዶ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለውን የኮምፒውተር ሞዴል ለማዘመን የደቡብ አፍሪካ፣የቻይና እና የጣልያን መረጃዎችን ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

Source: The model predicted how South Africans might go from being susceptible, to infected, to recovered from, and immune to, COVID-19.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gwateebereza engeri abantu b’omu ggwanga lya South Afirika gye bayinza okuva ku kubeera nga bayinza okukwatibwa ekirwadde ne batuuka okukwatibwa, okuwona n’okutuuka ekiseera nga tebakyasobola kukwatibwa COVID-19.
Yoruba: Àwòṣe náà se àsọtẹ́lè bí àwọn ará ilẹ̀ South Africa ṣíraalẹ̀ de, kí wọ́n kó, kí wọn ó padàbọ̀ sípò, kí wọn ó sì ní àjẹsára fún, àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Le modeli yabikezela ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bangase badlule kanjani ekubeni sengozini, bahlabeke, kuya ekululameni, futhi bavikeleke ku-COVID-19.
Hausa: Samfurin ya yi hasashen yadda ’yan Afirka ta Kudu za su iya fita daga sauƙin kamuwa, zuwa kamuwa da cuta, da murmurewa daga, da kuma rigakafi ga cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Mmotlolo o akantše ka moo Maafrika Borwa a ka tlogago go seemo sa go tsenega, go ya go sa go fetetšwa, go sa go fola go, le boitšhireletšo go COVID-19.
Amharic: ሞዴሉ ደቡብ አፍሪካውያን እንዴት ከኮቪድ-19 ተጋላጭነት፣ ወደ ታማሚነት ወደ ማገገም እና ወደ መቋቋም ሊሄዱ እንደሚችሉ ተንብዯል፡፡

Source: They predicted that the peak number of infections would occur 31 to 71 days after the start of the first wave.
Luganda: Baateebereza nti omuwendo gw’abantu abanaakwatibwa ekirwadde gujja gubaawo wakati w’ennaku 31 okutuuka ku nnaku 71 okuva olulumba olusooka we lwatandikira.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ pé iye ìkóràn tí ó pọ̀ jù yóò wáyé ní ọjọ́ 31 sí 71 lẹ́yìn tí ọwọ́jà àkọ́kọ́ ti bẹ̀rẹ̀.
Zulu: Babikezela ukuthi inani eliphakeme lokutheleleka/lokusuleleka lalizokwenzeka ezinsukwini ezingama-31 kuye kwezingama-71 ngemuva kokuqala kwegagasi lokuqala.
Hausa: Sun yi hasashen cewa adadin masu kamuwa da cutar zai iya faruwa a kwanaki 31 zuwa 71 bayan tashin farko.
Northern Sotho: Ba akantše gore palo ya sehloeng ya diphetetšo e tla hlaga matšatšing a 31 go fihla go a 71 ka morago ga go thomišwa ga lephoto la pele.
Amharic: የመጀመሪያው ሞገድ በጀመረ ከ31 እስከ 71 ቀናት ባሉት ጊዜዎች ውስጥ ከፍተኛው የኢንፌክሽኖች ቁጥር እንደሚከሰት ተንብየዋል፡፡

Source: They also predicted that South Africa would need 7000 to 18000 general hospital beds and 2350 to 6000 intensive care beds at the first peak.
Luganda: Baagenda mu maaso era ne bateebereza nti South Afirika ejja kwetaaga obutanda bw’omu malwaliro aga bulijjo obuli wakati wa 7000 ne 18000 n’obutanda bw’omu woodi z’abayi obuli wakati wa 2350 okutuuka ku 6000 ku ntikko y’olulumba olusooka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe àsọtẹ́lè pé South Africa máa nílò ilé-ìwòsàn ìjọba fún gbogbogbò tí ó ní tó ìbùsùn 7000 sí 18000 àti ìbùsùn ìmójútó sàn-án tí ó tó 2350 sí 6000 ní ìbújáde àkọ́kọ́.
Zulu: Baphinde futhi babikezela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika izodinga imibhede yezibhedlela ezijwayelekile eyi-7000 kuya kweyi-18000 kanye nemibhede yabagula kakhulu eyi-2350 kuya kweyi-6000 ekudlangeni kokuqala.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma yi hasashen cewa Afirka ta Kudu za ta buƙaci gadaje na asibiti 7000 zuwa 18000 da gadaje 2350 zuwa 6000 na kulawa a ƙololuwar farko.
Northern Sotho: Ba akantše le gore Afrika Borwa e tla hloka mepete ye 7000 go fihla go ye 18000 go sepetlele tša mmušo le mepete ye 2350 go fihla go 6000 ka phapošing ya balwetši bao ba bakwago le badimo go sehloa sa mathomo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ደቡብ አፍሪካ በመጀመሪያው ጫፍ ከ7000  እስከ18000 የጠቅላላ ሆስፒታሎች አልጋ እና ከ2350 እስከ 6000 የከፍተኛ እንክብካቤ አልጋዎች እንደሚያስፈልጋት ተንብየዋል፡፡

Source: Their models suggested that on 15 April 2020, there were two most likely future scenarios.
Luganda: Emitetenkanyirizo gyabwe gyalaga nti nga 15 Ogwokuna 2020, wayinza okugwawo ebintu bibiri.
Yoruba: Àwòṣe wọn dábàá pé ní 15 ọṣù kẹrin ọdún 2020, ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ọjọ́-iwájú méjì ni ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó ṣẹlẹ̀.
Zulu: Amamodeli abo aphakamise ukuthi ngomhlaka-15 kuNdasa 2020, bekunezimo ezimbili okungenzeka ukuthi zenzeke esikhathini esizayo.
Hausa: Samfuransu sun ba da shawarar cewa a ranar 15 ga watan Afrilu, shekara ta 2020, akwai yiwuwar yanayi guda biyu na gaba.
Northern Sotho: Dimmotlolo tša bona di šišintše gore ka la 15 Aprele 2020, go bile le ditiragalo tše pedi tše di ka hlagago ka moso.
Amharic: ሞዴሎቻቸው በኤፕሪል 15፣ 2020 ወደፊት ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ ሁለት ሁኔታዎች እንዳሉ ጠቁመዋል፡፡

Source: The first was that South Africa was still in the early stages of the first wave.
Luganda: Ekisooka kwe kuba nga South Afirika yali ekyali ku ntandikwa y’olulumba olusooka.
Yoruba: Àkọ́kọ́ ni pé ìpele ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọwọ́jà àkọ́kọ́ ni South Africa ṣì wà.
Zulu: Esokuqala kwaba ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yayisesezigabeni zokuqala zegagasi lokuqala.
Hausa: Na farko shi ne cewa har yanzu Afirka ta Kudu tana cikin matakin farko-farko na tashin farko.
Northern Sotho: Ya mathomo e bile ya gore Afrika Borwa e be e sa le dikgatong tša mathomo tša lephoto la pele.
Amharic: የመጀመሪያው፣ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ገና በመጀመሪያው ሞገድ አፍላ ደረጃዎች ላይ እንዳለች ነው፡፡

Source: And the second was that South Africa’s unique demographic and response were very effective at limiting COVID-19.
Luganda: Ekyokubiri kyali nti abantu b’omu South Afirika ab’enjawulo awamu n’ebintu bye bakoze byali bisobodde okuziyiza COVID-19.
Yoruba: Ikejì sì ni pé àwọn ènìyàn àti ìtakìjí South Africa tí ó ṣe àrà ọ̀tọ̀ náà jára mọ́ sísé àrùn COVID-19 dáadáa.
Zulu: Okwesibili kwaba ukuthi inani labantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nokusabela kwalo kwakusebenza kahle kakhulu ekunciphiseni i-COVID-19.
Hausa: Na biyu kuma shi ne keɓantaccen alƙaluman jama'a da amsawar gaggawar Afirka ta Kudu sun yi tasiri sosai wajen taƙaita cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Gomme ya bobedi e bile ya gore dipalopalo tša moswananoši le boitšhireletšo tša Afrika Borwa di be di šoma ka tshwanelo go fokotša COVID-19.
Amharic: ሁለተኛው ደግሞ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ልዩ የስነ-ህዝብ አወቃቀር እና ምላሽ ኮቪድ-19ን ለመገደብ በጣም ውጤታማ እንደነበር ነው፡፡

Source: The researchers provided the first model of COVID-19 for South Africa, which was thought to be a great tool to help governments and doctors make decisions on how to address COVID-19.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baawa South Afirika omutetenkanyirizo gwa COVID-19 ogusooka, ogwalowoozebwa okuba ekintu eky’omuwendo eky’okuyambako gavumenti n’abasawo mu kukola okusalawo ku ngeri y’okulwanyisaamu COVID-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàgbékalẹ̀ àwòṣe àkọ́kọ́ fún àrùn COVID-19 ní South Africa, èyí tí wọ́n lérò pé ó jẹ́ ohun-èèlò ńlá láti ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún àwọn ìjọba àti àwọn dókítà láti ṣe ìpinnu lórí ọ̀nà tí wọn yóò gba wo àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi banikeza imodeli yokuqala ye-COVID-19 eNingizimu Afrika, okwakucatshangwa ukuthi iyithuluzi elihle lokusiza ohulumeni nodokotela ukuthi benze izinqumo zokuthi bangabhekana kanjani ne-COVID-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da samfurin farko na cutar COVID-19 ga Afirka ta Kudu, wanda ake tunanin babban kayan aiki ne don taimakawa gwamnatoci da likitoci wajen yanke shawara a kan yadda za a magance cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba fane ka mmotlolo wa mathomo wa COVID-19 go Afrika Borwa, woo go bego go gopolwa gore e tla ba setlabela se bohlokwa go thuša mebušo le dingaka go tšea diphetho malebana le ka moo go ka šoganwago le COVID-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ መንግስታት እና ዶክተሮች ኮቪድ-19ን እንዴት መፍታት እንዳለባቸው ውሳኔ እንዲወስዱ ለመርዳት ጥሩ መሳሪያ ነው ተብሎ የታሰበውን የመጀመሪያውን የኮቪድ-19 ሞዴል ለደቡብ አፍሪካ አቅርበዋል፡፡

Source: They suggested that people closely monitor resources, such as available hospital beds and COVID-19 infections.
Luganda: Baateesa nti abantu basaanye balondoole ebikozesebwa, gamba ng’obutanda bw’omu malwaliro obuliwo awamu n’abantu abalina COVID-19.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dá a lábàá pé kí àwọn ènìyàn máa bójútó àwọn ohun-èèlò dáadáa, iye ìbùsùn tí ó wà nílẹ̀ ní ilé-ìwòsàn àti ìkóràn àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Baphakamisa ukuthi abantu baqaphe eduze izinsiza, njengemibhede yasesibhedlela etholakalayo kanye nokusuleleka ze-COVID-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa mutane su sa-ido sosai a kan kayayyaki, kamar gadajen asibiti da cututtukan cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gore batho ba tloge ba bea leihlo methopo, go swana le mepete ye e lego gona ya dipetlele le diphetetšo tša COVID-19.
Amharic: ሰዎች እንደ የሆስፒታል አልጋዎች አቅርቦት የመሳሰሉ ግብአቶችን እና የኮቪድ-19 ኢንፌክሽኖችን በቅርበት እንዲቆጣጠሩ ጠቁመዋል፡፡

Source: Then, governments could compare these numbers and model predictions to guide them in knowing how strongly to limit COVID-19 spread.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma, gavumenti ziyinza okugeraageranya emiwendo gino n’ebiteeberezo by’omutetenkanyirizo bibaluŋŋamye mu kumanya engeri esinga gye bayinza okukozesa okuziyiza ensaasaana ya COVID-19.
Yoruba: Nígbà náà, àwọn ìjọba lè ṣàfiwéra àsọtẹ́lè àwọn nọ́ḿbà àti àwòṣe yìí gẹ́gẹ́ bí atọ́nà fún wọn láti mọ̀ tí ó lágbára jùlọ láti kápá ìtànká àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Bese ke, ohulumeni bekwazi ukuqhathanisa lezi zinombolo kanye nezibikezelo eziyimodeli ukuze zibaqondise ekwazini ukuthi banganciphisa kanjani ngamandla ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19.
Hausa: Bayan haka, gwamnatoci suna iya kwatanta waɗannan alƙaluma da samfurin tsinkaya don jagorantarsu sanin yadda da ƙarfi za a yaɗuwar cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ke moka, mebušo e ka bapetša dipalopalo tše le dikakanyo tša mmotlolo gore di e lemoše gore e tsebe ka moo e ka fokotšago ka maatla phatlalalo ya COVID-19.
Amharic: ከዚያም መንግስታት የኮቪድ-19 ስርጭትን በምን ያህል አጥብቀው መገደብ እንዳለባቸው ምሪት እንዲያገኙ እነዚህን ቁጥሮች እና የሞዴል ትንበያዎች ማወዳደር ይችላሉ፡፡

Source: The researchers caution that they used their own judgement when updating some parts of the model.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza balabula nti baakozesa kutegeera kwabwe nga bazza obuggya ebitundu by’omutetenkanyirizo ebimu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà pè fún ìṣọ́ra pé ìdájọ́ titi wọn ní wọ́n lò nígbà tí wọ́n ń se ìmúgbòòrò sí àwọn apá kọ̀ọ̀kan nínú àwòṣe náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayisa ngokuthi basebenzisa ukwahlulela kwabo lapho bebuyekeza izingxenye ezithile zemodeli.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gargaɗi cewa sun yi amfani da nasu hukuncin a lokacin sabunta wasu sassan samfurin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemoša gore ba šomišitše kwešišo ya bona ge ba mpshafatša dikarolo tše dingwe tša mmotlolo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የሞዴሎቹን አንዳንድ ክፍሎች ሲያዘምኑ የራሳቸውን ምዘና እንደተጠቀሙ ያሳስባሉ፡፡

Source: They said that future studies should use other models to do so instead.
Luganda: Baagamba nti okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja kusaanye kukozese emitetenkanyirizo emirala okukola ekyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé kí àwọn ìwádìí ọjọ́-iwájú lo àwọn àwòṣe mìíràn láti ṣe é.
Zulu: Bathe izincwaningo ezizayo kufanele zisebenzise ezinye izinhlobo ukwenza lokho esikhundleni.
Hausa: Sun ce ya kamata bincike na gaba ya yi amfani da wasu samfura don yin a maimakon haka.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore dinyakišišo tša ka moso di swanetše go šomiša dimmotlolo tše dingwe go dira seo.
Amharic: ወደፊት የሚሰሩ ጥናቶች ይሄንን ለመስራት ሌሎች ሞዴሎችን መጠቀም አለባቸው ይላሉ፡፡
